rationale: The provided evidence records support optimizations for distributed dependency caching (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE), failure-first job ordering (P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST), build prioritization (P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY), and scheduled failure suppression (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE). This workflow is a lightweight hourly scheduled check that queries an external API (erlang/otp releases) and triggers a downstream build only when a new release candidate appears. It has no dependency installation step to cache, its matrix size is always one (so job reordering is irrelevant), it does not contend for queued build resources, and its recent run history shows only a single non-consecutive failure (not a repeated failure streak). Therefore, none of the evidence-supported patterns apply to this workflow's structure and operational context.
